text:
micah: Anyone able to grant me read logs in prod-console for a quick PII redaction check? Need to grep request ids for ticket #4562. ETA ~30m.

sasha: What's the minimum scope you need? Project-level Viewer? Or just Logs Viewer?

micah: Logs Viewer on project `redwood-prod` should be fine. Need to access cloud logs UI and run a filter.

security-bot: Reminder: approvals required for prod access > 15m. Please include justification + approval from eng-security.

micah: Justification: investigating potential PII exposure in generated summaries. Ticket: RDW-4562. Access window 30 minutes.

jamie: @sasha I can approve for 30m if team ok. Micah we'll need to use ephemeral role via JIT flow.

alex: For JIT, run: `./tools/jit-request --role=roles/logging.viewer --duration=30m --project=redwood-prod` or use the console JIT UI.

micah: thanks, trying now.

oncall-sre: Also add: you'll only need `roles/logging.viewer` binding, not project viewer. Confirmed minimal.

micah: Got it. Follow-up: will log UIDs be redacted? My filter will look for `request_id:RDW-4562`.

sasha: Good catch. If you see raw PII, take screenshots but don't download logs. We'll redact and run a sweep. @security-bot please note.

security-bot: Access granted via JIT: micah for 30m (roles/logging.viewer) — request id jit-7890. Audit will be logged.

micah: Access works. Found 2 occurrences, flagging in ticket, cc @jamie. Leaving notes in RDW-4562. :white_check_mark:

jamie: Thanks. Once redaction PR is ready, ping me for deploy. Also recommend adding a log sanitizer rule to strip PII at ingestion.
